# Once v0.2.1

Changes since v0.2.0, grouped by platform.

## Across all platforms

- **A rationalised design system.** Spacing, type and radius now come from one
  documented token scale instead of 175 single-use custom properties, settings
  own their shell styling, and every settings button shares one skin. Icons
  moved onto the token set as well, so glyph sizing is consistent across
  surfaces. The contract is written down in `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` and guarded
  by the CSS debt and cascade checks.
- **More durable story state.** Local defaults no longer overwrite state that
  arrived from sync, PouchDB revisions are bounded and consolidated so databases
  stop growing without limit, and local index cleanup is no longer destructive.
- **Steadier sync setup and startup.** Configuring sync and picking the story to
  show at startup are both hardened against partial or damaged state.
- **Reload markers in the error log** make it clear which entries belong to the
  current run.
- Smaller fixes: tag icons are sized correctly, the version number in settings
  can be selected and copied, and deleting a populated group asks properly
  instead of failing.

## Electron (desktop) and extensions (Firefox & Chrome)

- **Keyboard navigation.** The desktop shell is now operable without the mouse.
  A single capture-phase dispatcher resolves chords to commands and guards text
  entry, so bare letters never reach a typist and Ctrl+Arrow still works in the
  settings editors. Chords resolve keycap-first and position-second, so Ctrl+Z
  follows the Z key on a German layout while WASD stays a cluster under the left
  hand.
- **A story cursor** tracks the story rather than the row, so it survives
  re-sorting, refiltering and list rebuilds. Enter opens the story under the
  cursor, left and right run the configured first-stage swipe action, and
  clicking a row adopts it.
- **Bindable story actions.** Key commands are a registry rather than a fixed
  list, and every story context-menu action is registered and bindable (unbound
  by default). Bindings can be cleared to nothing, and a refused chord explains
  what already holds it.
- **A readable shortcut editor.** Shortcut groups are bordered, foldable boxes
  with aligned chord slots, so the list stays navigable now that every story
  action can be bound.

## Electron (desktop)

- Added a setting for the current story position.
- Closed-tab history with navigation snapshots, and configured chords are
  forwarded out of a focused page — unmodified keys are refused so a binding
  cannot swallow typing on a site.
- `body[data-pane-focus]` shows which pane the keys will reach, highlighting
  either the story cursor or the active tab.

## Mobile (Android & iOS)

- **Undo snackbar** for story actions, with its own settings including how long
  it stays up.
- Mobile startup and story sync are stabilised.
- Fixed settings style regressions from the design system work, and the warning
  surface now uses the shared status glyph token.
- The Reading menu is hidden on platforms that do not have it.

## Build and tests

- Line endings are enforced as LF repo-wide.
- Electron test windows stay off the developer's desktop during runs.
- Expanded settings visual-comparison coverage, retained visual-comparison runs
  are protected from cleanup, and Electron tests click semantic panel controls
  rather than raw elements.
